Editor fixes.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Long notes open at full height instead of growing into it.
- Pasted formatting always saves, and the title no longer loses focus while you type.
- Note cards read escaped pipes and line breaks in table cells.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.3.8...v0.3.9](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.3.8...v0.3.9)
